# OpenAPI contract

A machine-readable description of an HTTP API in the OpenAPI Specification format, listing its endpoints, parameters, request bodies, and responses. Clients and servers can be checked against it, and tools can generate code and documentation from it.

**See also**

- <https://spec.openapis.org/oas/latest.html>
